metadata.title: Intel, Amazon, Reddit, Chevron, Exxon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Intel, Amazon, Reddit, Chevron, Exxon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stock futures were mixed on Monday as technology shares sold off on the back of earnings but oil companies benefited from surging profits, fueled by the Iran conflict.
